entities.name: Vlastimil Válek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vlastimil Válek is a Czech radiologist and politician, who served as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Health from 17 December 2021 to 15 December 2025, in the cabinet of Petr Fiala. He has been a member of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Republic since 2017, representing TOP 09.
